description: This header file declares functions related to random number generation in libcurl, including functions for generating random data, hexadecimal strings, and alphanumeric strings. It also references a Windows-specific random function.

methods.name: Curl_rand
methods.description: Generates a buffer of random bytes.

methods.name: Curl_rand_hex
methods.description: Fills a buffer with random hexadecimal characters plus a null terminator.

methods.name: Curl_rand_alnum
methods.description: Fills a buffer with random alphanumeric characters plus a null terminator.

methods.name: Curl_win32_random
methods.description: Windows-specific function to generate random bytes, used for shared randomness on Windows.
